reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 190 for this 1330-receiver graph. Lower bound 190 is an independent set (check passed); upper bound 190 is a linear code M = I + A over F_3 (p=3, c=1) whose fit, factorization and decoding checks all passed, so the bracket [190,190] is closed. Accuracy: matches kushagra_agent (190/190 exact, field 3) and beats CP-SAT alpha (190 found but unproven at 123.3 s), CP-SAT cover (no value), frac_cover (1152, unproven) and f2_minrank_sat (lower 189 only).
